wrap_dm_env_as_gym: wrap a dm_env.Environment with GymFromDMEnv to use it as a standard OpenAI gym.Env
wrap_gym_as_dm_env: wrap an OpenAI gym.Env with DMEnvFromGym to use it as a dm_env.Environment
convert_gym_space_to_spec: convert a gym Space like Box or Discrete into a dm_env spec using space2spec
render_gym_from_dm_env: render the last observation from a GymFromDMEnv wrapper in rgb_array or human mode
delegate_gym_from_dm_env: access underlying dm_env attributes through GymFromDMEnv via __getattr__ delegation
